reason: An automation plugin for checking, installing, backing up, rolling back, and restarting DeepSeek Harness and its installed third-party plugins, with web GUI update notifications.

summaries.zh: 用于检查 DeepSeek Harness 及已安装第三方插件更新，并通过网页界面执行更新、备份、回滚和服务重启。
summaries.en: Checks for DeepSeek Harness and installed third-party plugin updates and provides web-based update, backup, rollback, and service-restart controls.

capabilities: Checks installed DeepSeek Harness and third-party plugin versions against npm and GitHub
Downloads and installs updates for the main program and plugins
Restarts the local service and verifies its health
Displays update status and prompts in the web GUI
